mementos.title: Kujuppama Beach

kind_data.name: Kujuppama Beach
kind_data.note: A seaside memory from the Izu trip.

mementos.essay: The first beach stop gave our team a bright pause by the water. We shared the shoreline, let the trip slow down, and carried that easy feeling into the BBQ that followed.

mementos.title: Jogasaki Coast

kind_data.name: Jogasaki Coast
kind_data.note: A coastal cliff view from the second day.

mementos.essay: On the coast, our team followed the edge between dark rock and open water. It was a quieter second-day memory—the kind of walk that leaves the sea in everyone's conversation.
mementos.author_note: Matched from IMG_2708.jpeg EXIF GPS and the GPX coastal stop.
